comment: Copy to local.json next to local.py and adjust. Every key is optional; leave one out to keep config.json's value.
comment_test_command: Replaces ./bin/phpunit in the build rules, and shell(./bin/phpunit:*) with shell(<first word>:*) in the allowed tools. shell(make:*) allows every Makefile target.
comment_stack_hint: Replaces 'Use the existing Symfony 7 / PHP stack and PHPUnit' in the Spec Kit plan prompt. Other frameworks have no stack hint.
stack_hint: Use the existing PHP stack and PHPUnit; tests run in Docker with make test
comment_model: Copilot model. Leave it out to use config.json's model.
comment_copilot: The command that starts Copilot CLI, as a list. Leave it out to use copilot from PATH. On Windows it must not be a .cmd or .bat file.
comment_jira: Jira credentials come from the environment, never from this file: JIRA_BASE_URL, JIRA_API_TOKEN, and JIRA_EMAIL for Jira Cloud only (Basic auth). Without JIRA_EMAIL, the token goes out as a Bearer token (Jira Data Center personal access token).
